text:
maya: heads up — rerank eval CI started showing nondeterministic NDCG/MRR diffs after the 2-bit quantize bring-up. about 1/5 runs fail with small NDCG regressions.
liam: ugh, seen this. failing jobs show tiny order swaps on tied scores. could be unstable sort + multithread aggregator.
jon: do we have logs? upload from the failing run?
sasha: failing log: `query=Q123, top_docs: [D5(score=0.821), D12(score=0.821), D3(score=0.820)]` then next run swaps D12/D5 order -> NDCG delta ~0.003.
maya: attaching snippet from runner:
```
# simplified collector
results = []
for shard in shards:
    results.extend(shard.partial_results)
results.sort(key=lambda r: r['score'], reverse=True)
# then compute per-query ndcg on topk
```
liam: sort is unstable when scores are equal and we merge concurrent shards without deterministic tie-breaker. quantization increased score ties.
jon: that makes sense — quantization reduces score resolution so ties spike.
sasha: proposed fix: stable sort with deterministic tie-breaker (query_id, score, doc_id) + ensure aggregator runs single-threaded reduce step or uses deterministic merge. also set RNG seed for any sampling.
maya: also we should change CI: run rerank suite with fixed seeds and add a tolerance-based assertion rather than exact equality. small floating diffs ok but order swaps that change metrics significantly should fail.
liam: I'll draft a PR. plan: (1) change collector sort to `sorted(results, key=lambda r: (r['query_id'], -r['score'], r['doc_id']))` (2) add unit test that simulates score ties and checks stable topk ordering (3) CI: add `--eval-seed=42` env and add flaky-run detection in ci-bot.
jon: please also add a metric-level regression threshold config. e.g., ndcg_tolerance=1e-4 per-run, and a per-suite escalator if >3 consecutive flaky runs.
sasha: adding dashboard note: Dashboard -> rerank/weekly shows spikes in tie-count since quantize rollouts on 2026-02-28. we should surface tie-rate as a telemetry metric.
ci-bot: triggered job 5123 re-run (attempt 2) — https://ci.redwood.ai/job/5123
evalbot: recorded failure: ndcg_delta=-0.00312 on run 5123 (test: msmarco-rerank). grouped by query shows 7 queries affected.
maya: liam — can you include a small repro harness in your PR that runs the ms-marco slice with quantized model to show fails -> fixed?
liam: yep. I'll target branch `fix/collector-determinism` and link PR when ready: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2145
jon: ping me for review, I can help with the dashboard/tie telemetry.
sasha: small note — keep metric computation centralized to avoid rounding differences between nodes. move metric aggregator to single process after reduce.
maya: agreed. timeline: liam will open PR today, we aim to land by EOD tomorrow, then run two full CI cycles.
liam: starting patch now. will add tests and update CI config. :hammer_and_wrench: 
maya: thanks. 
sasha: sweet. :rocket:
